mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger is met but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) of more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months signals a rapidly weakening labor market, which will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE trigger is met but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show y-o-y declines of more than 5%, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both HOUST and RSAFS y-o-y declines exceed 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 0.5% per month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising > 0.5% per month but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is growing by more than 200,000 per month, it signals a tight labor market that will boost wage growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200k per month but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the industrial production index (INDPRO) is above 110 and rising by more than 0.5% per month, it signals strong supply-side momentum that will lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trigger is met but SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing by more than 3% y-o-y and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a strong and broadening economic expansion that will lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 y-o-y growth > 3% and UNRATE falling but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 35% of instances.
